meta.title: An upcoming event can be seen but not bid on
warnings: resolved: “Assert that the upcoming event's start time is shown in the vendor portal.” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

plan.title: Upcoming event cannot be bid on

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ without creating or searching for another event.
Move to Vendor A's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the upcoming RFQ's pricing round from the vendor event list.
Verify the vendor cannot submit a quote before the event start time.
Try entering and submitting a price, requiring the portal to refuse the bid.
